question.title: 第5题：把对话排排队
question.stem: 第5题：把对话排排队。把下面 A、B 的句子排成一段通顺对话。
question.original_question:
A: Can you help me with my laptop? Something's wrong with it, and I don't know much about laptops.
B: I don't know much either.
A: Oh! So you can't help me, then?
B: Not really. I'm sorry.
A: No problem. I'll call Jenny in a minute, she'll probably know.
B: Good idea. She's really good with these things. Oh - hang on! How about if you press this button here?
A: Oh, yes, that's fixed it! Well done. Thank you.
question.student_answer: 1 A求助电脑 → 2 B Not really. I'm sorry. → 3 A then → 4 B either → 5 A call Jenny → 6 B Good idea → 7 A fixed it
question.standard_answer: 1 A Can you help me with my laptop? → 2 B I don't know much either. → 3 A Oh! So you can't help me, then? → 4 B Not really. I'm sorry. → 5 A No problem. I'll call Jenny… → 6 B Good idea. / hang on / How about… → 7 A that's fixed it!
question.explanation_zh: either 表示「也」，必须接在前面的 I don't know much 之后；then 是得出结论。学生把 B 的道歉提前，因果就倒了。

lines.speaker: B

narration.text: 第五题，把对话排排队。口诀先记：先找开头，再看答句，连接词是关键。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you help me with my laptop? Something's wrong with it, and I don't know much about laptops.
lines.zh: 能帮我看看笔记本电脑吗？它出毛病了，我不太懂电脑。

scenes.tip: 对话一般从求助或提问开始

narration.text: Can you help me with my laptop?
有人在求助，这句就是第一句。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I don't know much either.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh! So you can't help me, then?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not really. I'm sorry.

scenes.tip: either 要跟着前面的 I don't know much；then 用来下结论

narration.text: 第二步看答句。either 是「也」，得接在 A 说不太懂之后。所以第二句是：
A 用 then 下结论，B 这才道歉。顺序不能倒。

scenes.title: 小心陷阱：顺序错了会怎样？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you help me with my laptop?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not really. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh! So you can't help me, then?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I don't know much either.

wrong.why: 先道歉再说 either，就像积木搭错，整段对话会倒。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you help me with my laptop?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I don't know much either.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh! So you can't help me, then?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not really. I'm sorry.

right.why: either 接「也不懂」；then 下结论后，B 才说抱歉。

narration.text: 常见错法：B 先道歉，再补 either。因果反了。要么先说也不懂，再用 then 收口，最后才抱歉。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No problem. I'll call Jenny in a minute, she'll probably know.
lines.zh: 没关系，我一会儿打给 Jenny，她可能知道。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Good idea. Oh - hang on! How about if you press this button here?
lines.zh: 好主意！哦——等等！试试按这个按钮怎么样？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh, yes, that's fixed it! Well done. Thank you.
lines.zh: 哦，对了，修好啦！干得好，谢谢！

scenes.tip: fixed it 表示已经修好，所以这句放最后

narration.text: 后半段：A 说没关系，去找 Jenny。
No problem. I'll call Jenny in a minute.
B 先说好主意，再突然想到按这个键。A 说修好了，所以放最后。
